note: DATA, NOT CODE. app/rbi/manifest.py iterates this file; no document is
hardcoded in Python. Adding a source is a manifest edit.
SIX OF THE TWENTY-THREE DOCUMENTS ARE PRESENT (2026-09-21):
RBI-IT-GOV-2023, RBI-IT-OUTSOURCE-2023, RBI-FS-OUTSOURCE-NBFC-2017,
RBI-DIGITAL-LENDING-2025, RBI-FRAUD-NBFC-2024 and
RBI-NBFC-CREDIT-INFO-REPORTING-2025. Each carries source_status
'downloaded', a local_path pointing at the stored PDF, and identity
fields read from that file's own first pages. Those six, and only those
six, may be cited from.
EVERY OTHER ENTRY RECORDS IDENTITY ONLY. It states what a document is
and what it governs; it does not contain the document. Such an entry
carries source_status other than 'downloaded' and local_path null, and
nothing may be quoted, paged or clause-referenced from it. Recording a
document's existence and having read it are different claims, and
is_citable() is the line between them.
source_url is null except where an exact document URL was actually
verified. An invented URL would be worse than an absent one: it would
look resolvable and could send an ingestion run at the wrong document.
WRONG DOCUMENTS THAT WERE REJECTED RATHER THAN INGESTED. Files first
obtained for Digital Lending 2025 and Fraud Risk Management (NBFC) 2024
were RBI PRESS RELEASES announcing those instruments, not the
instruments; they were not ingested, and the real Directions have since
replaced them. A file obtained for credit-information reporting was the
GENERIC Directions of 2025-01-06 (RBI/DoR/2024-25/125) rather than the
NBFC-specific instrument; it was not ingested either, and
RBI-NBFC-CREDIT-INFO-REPORTING-2025 (2025-11-28) is used instead.
SUPERSESSION IS RECORDED FROM EVIDENCE, NOT ASSUMED.
RBI-DIGITAL-LENDING-2022 and RBI-DLG-2023 are marked
superseded_in_scope because Annex III of the 2025 Directions lists both
by circular number among the circulars that 'stand repealed' under its
clause 30(i). Each carries a regulatory_status_note saying so.

source_status_values.downloaded: The exact source document is present at local_path and its identity was verified against it.
source_status_values.not_downloaded: Identity is recorded; the document itself has not been obtained. Nothing may be cited from it.
source_status_values.exact_url_unresolved: As above, and the only known URL is an RBI index/listing page rather than the document itself, so even an automated fetch cannot resolve it without human action.
source_status_values.current_version_unresolved: As above, and which version is operative for the target entity type is itself unresolved.

regulatory_status_values.current: In force and operative for the entities listed in applicability.
regulatory_status_values.draft: Published for comment. Provisional -- findings against it are consultative, never binding.
regulatory_status_values.committee_report: Background/rationale material. Not a direction and not binding.
regulatory_status_values.historical: Superseded or foundational. Must never outrank a current source.
regulatory_status_values.superseded_in_scope: Superseded, within the scope named in supersedes/superseded_by.
regulatory_status_values.to_be_superseded: Still operative but explicitly slated for replacement.

documents.scope_note: Addressed on its face to 'All Non-Banking Financial Companies (including Housing Finance Companies)'. The file obtained earlier under this name was an RBI press release announcing all three; this is the NBFC instrument itself. EXTRACTION NOTE: pypdf occasionally reorders lines around footnote markers in this document, so a small number of clause attributions may be imprecise -- see docs and tests/rag/test_pdf_extract.py.

applicability.note: Addressed to all NBFCs including HFCs. Several chapters apply specifically to NBFCs in the Upper and Middle Layers (NBFCs - UL & ML); layer-specific scope is stated clause by clause in the document and is not modelled here.
